Hey friends, for the last five years I've spent over $100,000 a year on business coaches, mentors and events, which raises a fair question: why pay for business advice when so much of it is free online? In this vlog I take you inside a four-day entrepreneur event in Thailand hosted by my mentor Taki Moore, from a mastermind on boats to a webinar workshop with Jason Fladlien and a podcast with Maria Wendt. At the end, we work out together whether it was actually worth the money. Hope you enjoy xx

videos.title: Essentials: Manage Stress & Build Resilience | Dr. Elissa Epel
videos.description:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Elissa Epel, PhD, a Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF). We discuss how acute and chronic stress affect the body and brain, including their links to cellular aging and mitochondrial health. We also explain tools to reduce rumination, reframe stress as a challenge and build resilience, as well as how radical acceptance and a sense of purpose can help us navigate stressors we cannot change.
